tutorial.heading: Tutorial
tutorial.welcome.title: Four goals, sixty hours a week
tutorial.welcome.body: You win by meeting all four goals — wealth, happiness, education and career — before anyone else. Every week gives you 60 hours, and everything you do spends some of them.
tutorial.travel.title: Getting around costs time
tutorial.travel.body: Head to the employment office. Every step along the street costs hours, and later you can buy faster ways to travel.
tutorial.apply.title: Apply for a job
tutorial.apply.body: Every job lists what it needs: a uniform, a degree, or enough dependability. The entry job here will always take you on.
tutorial.work.title: Work a shift
tutorial.work.body: Go to your workplace and work. A shift pays you, and it slowly builds the dependability and experience that better jobs ask for.
tutorial.eat.title: Eat something
tutorial.eat.body: Buy a meal. Skip too many weeks and you go hungry, which costs you hours and happiness.
tutorial.enrol.title: Enrol at the university
tutorial.enrol.body: Degrees take a course fee and a series of lessons. They raise your education goal and open up the jobs worth having.
tutorial.relax.title: Go home and relax
tutorial.relax.body: Relaxing at home raises happiness, and things you own at home make each session count for more.
tutorial.endTurn.title: End the week
tutorial.endTurn.body: Ending your turn moves the week on. Rent falls due every four weeks, and the weekend brings events you do not choose.
tutorial.bank.title: The bank, and the street
tutorial.bank.body: Money in the bank earns a little and cannot be stolen. Carrying a lot of cash past the bank or the grocery is how people get robbed.
tutorial.done.title: That is the loop
tutorial.done.body: Work, study, eat, rest, repeat — and watch the four bars at the top. The game carries on from here.
tutorial.hint.map: Open the map to choose your next place.

coach.label: Tip
coach.gig.title: Gig work
coach.gig.body: Sign up once at the employment office, then take shifts anywhere. Pay follows demand, so it changes week to week.
coach.loan.title: Loans
coach.loan.body: A loan pays out now and is repaid weekly with interest. Missed payments turn into debt that hurts your goals.
coach.subscription.title: Subscriptions
coach.subscription.body: Subscriptions bill every week until you cancel, and cancelling takes a visit here. Check the weekly total in the HUD.
coach.car.title: Cars
coach.car.body: A car saves walking hours but costs upkeep and loses value. Repair it before it breaks down.
coach.invest.title: Investing
coach.invest.body: Prices move every week and can fall as well as rise. Assets do not all move together.
coach.transit.title: Transit pass
coach.transit.body: A pass makes trips across town cheaper in hours. It pays off if you travel a lot.
coach.delivery.title: Delivery
coach.delivery.body: Delivery brings a meal home without the trip, for a fee. Handy when hours are short.
coach.online.title: Online study
coach.online.body: Study from home with a laptop and internet. Lessons count the same as in class.
